metadata.description: ABI-1 compiler-backend reply. The strict host reader accepts only bounded backend bytes or one bounded failure; compiler IR identity remains manager-owned.

backend-bytes: ok bytes_b64 is canonical padded standard base64 and decodes within the backend byte cap
reply-cap: the raw reply is bounded before JSON decoding and decoded-byte allocation
message: optional ok diagnostics are bounded and control-free; fail diagnostics are additionally nonblank
